tei:div.tei:p: '% "2 ༄// mnyam med sgam po pa chen po'i rnam rol khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po

dwags po bkra shis rnam par rgyal ba'i rnam thar mdor bsdus bzhugs so// mnyam med dwags po'i rnam rol gdan sa la gcig tu mdzad pa che ba khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po bkra shis rnam par rgyal ba'i gtam mdor bsdus tsam brjod pa ni/ de yang dus gsum kun mkhyen pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ bde chen gling pa'i gter kha lung bstan dam tshig gi bka' rgya las/ zla 'od gzhon nu'i sprul pa cig: sa gnas dngos gzhi 'byin pa cig: bkra shis dang ni rgyal gyi ming : 'on kyang de yis bde ba ster: zhes dang*/ gzhan yang rig 'dzin rgod ldem dang*/ sangs rgyas gling pa/ zhig po gling pa sogs gter kha mang po nas lung bstan/ rgyal ba nyid kyi lung gis yang yang bsngags pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa rje sgam po pas sho mo yar shog gi mgur gsungs dus khams pa mi gsum la pha wong 'di'i 'og nas shing 'bras bu can zhig skyes pa dang dus mtshungs par/ gnas 'dir kho bo'i sprul pa zhig 'byung zhes lung bstan pa'i skyes chen dam pa 'di nyid kyi mdzad pa la drug las/ dang por grub pa'i rigs su skye ba bzhes tshul ni/ de yang yab ni rje dwags po'i rigs dbon mnga' bdag chen mo chos dbang bar grags pa/ sngon bsags kyi 'bras bu dar bas gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ zhol stengs gsar ma'i gzhis ka btab pa sogs kyi bstan don bsgrubs pa/ stag seng kha sprod kyi gdams pa thugs nyams su bstar zhing*/ yun du gcod yul stan thog gcig ma la gzhol ba/ sbyor phu'i chu 'khris nas pha wong las gser mang po bton pa sogs grub pa'i spyod pa mang du mdzad pa de dang*/ yum yang mda' stong mche ba can gyi brgyud pa bla ma sangs rgyas bh+rum pa'i sras rgyud dwags stong rgyal por grags pa'i lcam rig 'dzin sgrol ma zhes mkha' 'gro'i mtshan ma tshang ba med cing*/ rnam par dkar ba'i mdzad pas dus 'da' ba/ khyad par dus chen rnams su gso sbyong la gnas shing sgrol ma dkar sngon yi dam du bsten pa de gnyis kyi sras su 'dod dgu du ma'i 'byung gnas rlan smad rgyal ba'i ldum rar/

dpal sdong zhes pa chu mo bya lo spyi lo 1513hor zla gsum pa'i tshes brgyad la me tog gi char/ snyan pa'i 'brug sgra dang bcas te sku bltams/ mtshan don yod rgya mtshor gsol/ de'i tshe zhabs rjes kyi brag 'khris kyi kham bu de yang skyes/ de nas yum gyis gtsang sbra dang bcas te sku skyed bsrings so// //gnyis pa gsan pa ris med du mdzad tshul ni/ thog mar yum gyis skyabs 'gro/ dwags bstod/ mdzad bcu sogs zhal 'don mdzad pa zhar la mkhyen te mnyam du 'don par mdzad| dgung lo lnga drug bar yab yum gar bzhugs su gzhon nu'i rol rtsed dang spel ba'i yig klog ci rigs gsan/ dgung lo bdun pa la sgam por khu bo'i drung du byon/ mtshan brjod rnam 'joms/ phag mo/ dgyes rdor/ bskang gso sogs thugs 'dzin dang*/ zhar la yi ge gzab bshar sbyangs pa phul phyin dgongs/ de nas slob dpon chos dpal bkra shis la brten nas/ thog mar bcu gcig zhal gyi cho ga de nyid bcu drug gsan/ gzungs sgrub kyi gral dbur phebs/ cho ga bsngo ba shis brjod sogs spobs pa'i gzengs dang bcas stsal bas thams cad dad pa'i sa la bkod/ khu bo yang mnyes pas/ thugs spro nas smyung bar gnas pa'i dkar chog yun ring du mdzad pas sgrib pa dag pa'i mnal ltas dang*/ dngos su nges 'byung skyo shas dang*/ byams snying rje 'phel bar gyur/ de nas dus 'khor dang*| kun rig gi cho ga phyag len/ bris thig rab gnas/ las bzhi'i sbyin bsreg dang bcas mtha' tshes dang*/ dkar rtsis byed grub kyi lnga bsdus/ gza' 'dzin| dus sbyor/ gza' lnga/ rgyu mtshan rtsis dang bcas gsan/ thar rgyan dang*/ spyod 'jug thugs 'dzin kyang mdzad/ mkhan po byang ram par brten nas sngags klog dus 'khor 'grel chen/ zab mo nang don 'grel pa dang bcas gsan pas phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi rnam bzhag la mkhyen pa thogs med du gyur| bzhugs yul phal cher bse mgul du mdzad/

de'i tshe sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin 'khrungs te ri brag la thogs med du 'byon pa dang*/ khyad par khu bo'i drung du 'byon nam bzhed sgom bde'i rtsig zur la thal byung du phebs pas/ kha cig gis mi ma yin gyis brlams zer/ phal cher ni ngo mtshar gyi gnas su gyur/ khu bo'i drung yang thugs ngo mtshar kyang*/ nga rgyal gcog pa'i phyir bkyon pa'i tshul mdzad/ dgung lo bcu bzhi la/ khu bo mkhan slob dang bcas pa'i drung du rab tu byung*/ mtshan bkra shis rnam rgyal chos kyi dpal bzang por gsol/ de skabs mkhan slob dang*/ gcen chos rje rab 'byams pa sogs kyis dbus gtsang la phebs pa 'thad tshul phul bar brten/ dpon slob nyung bsdus kyis snyug la legs bshad gling du phebs/ 'bul ba mang ja 'gyed bcas bzang zhing gya nom par mdzad/ der chu bzang slob dpon pas grogs dan pa mdzad de bsdus pa brtsis pa bde blag tu chags/ gdan sa shes rab rnam rgyal la brten nas/ phar phyin lung chen don mthun dang*/ mngon pa mdzod kyi gzhung ṭī ka dang bcas zhib par sbyangs/ mngon pa gong ma'i bshad pa'ang gsan/ 'dul ba'i spyi don rags pa rnams dang*| khyad par sum brgya pa dang*/ kā ri ka lnga bcu'i gzhung dang 'bru ṭīka kyang gsan/ sdom gsum dang*/ dbu ma'i spyi don la gsan pa rgya cher mdzad/ tshad ma la rtags skor 'ga' shas gsan/ rje rin po che karma phrin las pa las/ der ma 'thus pa'i mdo rgyud bstan bcos man ngag dbang khrid mtha' gcod dang bcas gsan pa rnams 'dir yi ge mang bas rnam thar chen mo dang gsan yig tu blta bar bya'o// rta rna dge slong bya bar/ sgra snyan ngag lañdza wārtu sogs zhar chos su gsan/ de ltar gsan pa rnams kyang thos lor ma lus par dpyad pa rnam par dag pas legs par dpyad de rgyal ba'i dgongs don phyin ci ma log par thugs su chud pas/ skabs der grwa sa de na bshad ston 'dzom zhing mkhyen pa che ba'i grags pas phyogs tha grur khyab/

de'i tshe thugs dgongs la/ slar gtsang phyogs kyi grwa sa che ba zhig tu byon te gsan pa ris med dpyis phyin du mdzad de/ rje btsun gyi sgrub gnas rnams su lto gos gtam gsum khyad du bsad pa'i sgrub pa yang dag cig mdzad dgongs kyang*/ dwags po nas chibs drel dang bcas pa'i spyan 'dren pa sleb pas sgam por phebs/ sgam po ba spyi sgos so so nas gzhi len gzab shoms su zhus pa'i gral rnams su mdo sngags gang la gang 'os kyi ljags bshad rgyas par stsal/ khyad par khu bo chos kyi rje dang*/ gcen chos rje rab 'byams pa/ mkhan chen shākya bzang po sogs dge bshes chen po rnams dang*/ dri lan gyi tshul du gzhung chen mang po mtha' gcod dang bcas rgyas par gsungs pas/ khong rnams thugs yid ches te| sngar mkhas pa'i snyan pa byung ba don mthun du 'dug ces gleng*/ de nas mkhan chen rin po cher/ gsang sngags rgyud 'bum gyi lung gsan/ khu bo'i drung du| slar dbus gtsang la phebs pa'i dgongs zhus gnang yang*/ khu bo nyid gdan sa spo ba'i ring khyad kyis bka' nan mdzad pas ldog ma thub/ dgung lo nyi shu pa chu pho 'brug lo gsar 'phral/ thub dbang gnyis pa 'dzam gling grags pa'i seng ge'i khri bkod pa du mas mngon par brgyan te gdan sa rin po cher mnga' gsol ba'i dga' ston dang*/ chos rje ru pa bsam gtan rgya mtsho dang*/ sprul sku bsod nams rin chen gnyis kyis zhabs bteg nas/ nā ro dang*/ mar pa'i sku bzhengs pa'i rab ston sbrel ba'i mchod mo che nyin zhag mang por mdzad/ 'bri stag kar gsum sogs phyogs kyi bla chen dang*/ sde dpon che dgu rnams kyis so so nas 'bul stobs 'gran pa bzhin du mdzad/ de'i tshe nam mkha' nas rol mo'i sgra dang me tog gi char sogs ngo mtshar mang pos skye dgu rnams mos dge'i dpal la spyod par bkol/ khu bo'i dgongs pa ltar/ mkhan chen shākya bzang po las/ phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor/

chos drug gser zhun ma/ phag mo lha khrid| rdzogs rim rlung sems gnyis med kyi khrid dang*/ rdo rje phreng ba dang*/ mi tra brgya rtsa sogs dbang lung mang du gsan/ khu bo chos kyi rje rin po che'i drung du| thugs dam bde mchog lha lnga dang*/ phag mo lha lnga'i dbang*/ tshe dpag grub rgyal lugs/ bcu gcig zhal phyag rdor u tsar+yā/ gtum chung*/ sgrol dkar| rnam 'joms sogs kyi dbang rjes gnang mang po dang*/ dwags po bka' 'bum/ phyag chen rgya gzhung*/ chos bzhi rtsa 'grel/ bka' gdams glegs bam sogs mdor na dpe mdzod na ji ltar bzhugs pa'i lung mtha' dag gsan/ khyad par phyag chen gyi lta sgom skyong tshul rnams dris lan gyi tshul du gnang bas/ don brgyud kyi 'pho ba thob ste mnyam med dwags po'i gsung spyi dang*/ khyad par gab pa mngon phyung gi dgongs don mngon du gyur pas bka' drin mtshungs zla med par gyur| lo de ka'i sa ga zla ba'i bco lnga'i dus chen la sgom bde rtse'i mchod khang du/ brtan mkhas kyi yon tan mngon du gyur pa khu bo chos kyi rje rin po ches mkhan po dang*| mkhan shākya bzang pos slob dpon/ gcen chos rje rab 'byams pas gsang ston dang dus bgo mdzad de/ dge 'dun bcu phrag gi dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs te bcas rang gi nyes pa phra mos kyang ma gos pas 'dul 'dzin mang po'i 'byung gnas su gyur/ de nas lo gsum bar khri thog tu phebs dgos tsam ma gtogs/ gdan sa'i lugs gnyis kyi bkod khyab khu bo nyid kyi mdzad pas/ sgom bde rtser sku mtshams gnang ste dpe mdzod kyi phyag dpe rnams la gzigs te dpyad pa zhib tu gnang bas/ gsung rab kun la thogs pa med pa'i smra ba por gyur cing*/ bde dgyes phag mo sogs yi dam mang po zhig la bsnyen sgrub kyang rtags thon du mdzad do// //gsum pa thos bsam gyi don sgom pas nyams su blangs tshul ni/ dred 'brang chu mig nag por gzims khang kor bcas dbyar thog cig la grub par mdzad de/

mchod chen la phebs dgos tsam ma gtogs/ lo gsum lhag tsam der bcad rgya dam du gnang ste mnyam bzhag 'ba' zhig la thugs gzhol yang cung zad skyong dka' bas/ spyir gtum mo'i rnal 'byor dang khyad par mchog gi gtum mo gtso bor mdzad/ 'phrul 'khor kyang chag med du gnang bas rlung dhū tīr tshud pa'i rtags snang mang du shar/ thun bar rnams su mnyam med dwags po sogs bka' brgyud gong ma'i gsung gi snying po gang 'dug la gzigs| skabs re zangs lung du sku 'bum rin po che'i drung du phebs/ dad gus drag pos gsol 'debs dang smon lam mdzad/ de skabs zhal skor 'bum pa'i 'khris su mnyam med rin po che dang dngos su mjal/ 'gro phan rgya cher 'byung ba'i byin rlabs lung bstan par mdzad/ de'i tshe bla ma nyi ma grags pas rje nyid sku bgres gzhon gnyis su mjal/ gzims khang gi mdun du zhabs rjes kyang byung*/ gzhan la yi dam chos skyong zhal gzigs pa rnams dag pa rab 'byams su shar ba las 'os med du byas nas ma bris pa'o// yang shor re tsam gu ru steng gong 'og dang*/ spang me long gi phug pa rnams su phebs te thugs dam la rtsal 'don gnang bas snang ba dang rtog pa sgom du mi bde ba las grol nas tha mal shes pa gnyug ma'i bzhugs tshul phyin ci ma log pa mkhyen te mnyam med dwags po bzhed pa'i lta sgom mngon du gyur/ snang srid kyi 'char sgo rkyen bzang ngan sogs gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos thams cad ro mnyam du gyur pas mnyam med dwags po la mi phyed pa'i dad pa skyes/ de phyin dge sbyor la thob shor dang 'phel 'grib med gsung*/ de nas kyang dben gnas sgros che chung dang*/ byang 'bab rom sogs gnas chen mang por thugs dam la rtse gcig tu gzhol bar mdzad pas/ tshig don gnyis kar bsgrun du med pa'i nyams mgur kyang mang du gsungs/ gdan sa nyid du'ang gtso bor sku mtshams kyi khongs nas bstan pa'i 'dzin skyong gnang ba yin no//

//bzhi pa bstan 'gro'i don mdzad tshul ni/ chos rje gong ma rnams kyi phyag bzhes ltar/ sngar rje mar pa yan gyi rten chen 'dug pa'i mus la rje btsun gyi sku bzheng par dgongs te/ yab yum gcung dang bcas par bka' bgros par 'phral du 'grub dka' ba'i gsung byung rung*/ rje nyid dkon mchog la gsol ba btab na mi 'grub pa mi srid dgongs/ bzheng par thugs thag bcad/ de'i tshe chos rje cham dgon pa dang*| chos sgo ba/ lho brag sku skye sogs bu chen mang du 'dus pa dbang dang gdams pas smin par mdzad/ chos sgo ba sogs mang po bsnyen rdzogs kyang bsgrubs| de rnams kyi zangs gser 'gran pa bzhin du phul/ yab yum gyis kyang gser mang du phul bas rten chen 'phral du grub/ gzungs gzhug rab gnas sogs rje nyid kyis phyag bdar te gnang bas byin rlabs phul du byung bar gyur/ skya ser mang por 'gyed chen dang*/ bal po rnams kyang dngos rdzas mang pos yi rangs par stsal/ rgya ston pas spyan drangs te rnyed rdor brgyud nas bde stengs/ zla dgon sogs su phebs/ de nas kyang sngu sgang khyung po sogs brgyud nas sgom sde nang ya gnyis dang*/ kar zur gyi sa khog tu phebs/ de dag so so'i bla dpon zhal ngo thams cad kyis zhabs spyi bor blangs/ gzhan yang skya ser mtha' dag smin grol la bkod/ 'bul ba yang so sor ci lcog tu phul bas dngos rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ der gser mdog chos rje grags pa bas mjal| dbang chos mang du zhus/ dmar khams su phebs dgos pa'i nan zhus mdzad kyang*/ rje nyid 'du long dang bstod grags khyad du bsad de sgrub pa la thugs rings pas zhal bzhes ma gnang bar yar chibs kha bsgyur te rim gyis sgam por phebs/ khams phyogs su lo gnyis song ba'i bar du yab dgung lo nga gnyis la gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyang grub skabs su 'dug der sku khyos kyi tshul du/ khu bo'i drung du brgya 'bul tshan mang po dang*/

bla mgo dang las 'dzin rnams la gang babs kyi rnam bzhag ri mthil gyi skya ser rnams la ja dar sogs kyis 'gyed chen bstsal/ dgung lo so gcig pa yos lor gcung thub dbang bstan 'dzin gdan sar bskos/ phyag zog mtha' dag der 'bul bar mdzad nas/ la stod phyogs su sgrub pa sha stag la 'byon dgongs tshe/ khu bo'i drung gis/ sku mched gsum drung du bsags te/ rje gong ma rnams kyi phyag bzhes ltar/ kho bos kyang rje bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dgongs rdzogs su til+li'i sku bzhengs pa yin/ da lta khyed sku mched sku bsod dang gang ci nas gra 'grigs skabs 'dir/ yab kyi dgongs rdzogs su/ mnyam med rin po che'i sku che ba zhig bzhengs pa 'thad gsungs par brten/ sku 'dra 'dzam gling dpal 'bar khri rgyab dang bcas bkod pa du mas khyad par du byas pa bzheng ba'i dbu btsugs/ de'i tshe karma pa mi bskyod rdo rje sgam por phebs par sgar ston dang 'bul ba rgya cher mdzad/ dpon slob nyung bsdus kyi dbu ru phyogs kyi gnas gzigs la phebs/ 'bri stag gi zhal ngos thog drangs bla dpon thams cad kyis gus pas btud/ dbang chos man ngag so sor gang 'dod du bstsal/ dge 'dun gyi sde rnams la'ang mang ja 'gyed bcas dang*| dbang chos sogs lugs gnyis kyi re ba gang bar mdzad/ 'ba' rom ka bzhi drug gi bla ma sogs hor gyi bla dpon thams cad mdun ma dril ba'i spyan 'dren slebs pas/ byang brum tsha nyin srib bar phebs/ zla ba gsum du 'bul ba ni sa bzhi bkab pa ltar gyur/ dbang lung khrid sogs dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te 'gro ba mang po thar pa'i lam du btsud nas/ 'ba' rom pa'i ri pa rnams kyis zhabs bteg ste sgam por phebs/ sku khyos kyi rnam pa so sor gang babs su gnang*| khams nas rgya ston nam mkha' legs pa dang*/ zhabs bde dbon po sogs kyis gser mang po phul bas rten chen lhag chil le byung*/

byang gi phyag zog phal cher la brten nas/ sgrub sde gsar pa'i mchod gzhis/ rdzis mgo mchod g.yag sgrub khang*/ 'du khang*/ rten gsum/ sgrub grwa dang bcas btsugs/ rje nyid kyang gtso bor chu mig nag por bzhugs pas/ sgrub pa lhur len mi mang du 'dus par/ phyag chen chos drug sogs so so'i skal pa dang 'tshams pa'i gdams pa gnang bas/ nyams myong la nges pa rnyed nas lam sna zin pa ni phal cher la byung zhing*/ chos thams cad tha mal shes pa'i klong 'byams su grol ba'i grub brnyes kyang mang du byung*/ de'i tshe sku 'dra 'dzam gling dpal 'bar kyang yongs su grub pas/ rab ston la/ khu bo chos kyi rje spyan drangs/ 'bul chen bzang ba dang*/ ri zhol skya ser thams cad la 'gyed chen rnam gzhag dang bcas gnang*/ bzo bo rnams kyang dngos po gya nom pas tshim par bstsal/ yang sgrub mchod chen mo'i cho ga phyag len dang*/ sgrig srol gyi thugs kha ma gang par/ phyag zhabs la bu khral bsdus te grwa tshang gsar 'dzugs gnang*/ bla ma nyi ma grags pa slob dpon du bskos/ gcung khri thog par gsang sngags pho brang gi gtsug lag khang dang*/ grwa khang 'debs pa'i ljags bkod gnang ste/ rje nyid sgrub sder sku mtshams lo gsum gyi bcad rgya'i khongs nas bug chos ni bar med du bstsal/ de bar gcung khri thog pas lha khang spyil bu dang bcas yongs su grub 'dug pa/ zhabs kyis bcags shing phyag nas kyang 'thor/ yang grwa tshang gi slob gnyer ba rnams phyag phyir khrid nas brag long phyogs su phebs/ grwa pa rnams slob gnyer kho na la bkol/ khu bor phul ba'i dgon gnas rnams zhabs kyis bcags/ gnam tsher khar sgrub grwa'i thebs sbyar/ skyol zam gdong du zhabs rjes dang*/ yon bdag cig gi g.yu la phyag nas zhus pas/ g.yu bzang gsum phyag mtheb sen mo'i rjes dang bcas gsal bar byon/ de dus chos rje rab 'byams pa yang khams phyogs nas 'bul stobs che bar bsnams nas byon pas/

sku mched bka' bgros te yum gyi dgongs rdzogs su gsang sngags pho brang du rdo rje 'chang gi sku brgyang mtho nyer bzhi pa bzhengs/ rten ston 'gyed chen rgya cher spros/ slar dar 'dam las bde dgyes dus 'khor gsang 'dus 'jigs byed sogs sngags sku mang po dang*/ mgon khang du gtso 'khor gsum pa phyag bzhi drug beng dung skyong*/ rnam sras sogs thog tshad lhag par bzhengs/ shing rtsi logs bris mchod cha dang bcas grub par mdzad| rab gnas kyang rje nyid kyis lhun chags par gnang*/ sngar sman bla dang*/ de nyid bcu drug gi gzungs sgrub sgom bder 'dzugs pa'i srol 'dug pa de'i khar| bde dgyes gsang gsum/ thugs dam bde mchog lha lnga dang*/ mgon po sogs kyi bris thig chog sgrig gar 'cham gyis brgyan pa sa ga zla ba'i dus chen la gtong ba'i rgyun btsugs/ mthun rkyen bogs yong rdzis mgos dang bcas sbyar/ thugs la zang zing 'du long 'di sa lam gyi bar chad du 'dug pas/ sgrub pa yang dag cig zhen te dpon slob gsum bros thabs su gnam mtsho'i do nang la phebs dgongs pa shar thabs su byon pa/ spod gsang gsum mdor 'bri gung yang ri ba 'dug pas shes te spyan drangs/ nyi khri ru bas 'bul ba cher byung ba rnams yang ri bar gnang ste/ 'ba' rom rdza de'ur phebs kyang 'du long cher byung bas sku mtshams shin tu dam par mdzad/ de skabs hor dpon thar pa 'bum 'das pa'i yar 'dren du phebs dgos pa'i zhu ba byung yang zhal bzhes ma gnang*/ slar byang zhus dang gdan 'dren pa skya mi mang po slebs nas zhu nan che bas phebs/ stag lung gzims spyil pa dang mjal 'dzom gnang*/ khong la dwags po chos bzhi'i lung bshad dang*/ phyag chen gyi lta sgom la dogs gcod kyi dri bar dris lan gyi tshul du phul/ gzhan yang 'ba' rom pa dang*/ rdza ras pa sogs bla mgo mang por 'dod chos dang*/ dpon karma dpal la tshe dbang brgya rtsa sogs so sor 'dod pa gang bar gnang*/

'bul zhabs kyang dpe bral du byung ba de nyid du bzhag nas gnam mtshor phebs rung mtsho mtha' bye bas nang dor phebs ma thub/ bkra shis do sogs nye kor gyi ri sul rnams su ci bder bzhugs/ khro rgyal 'bum dang lha srung sogs dpon tshang rnams kyis dbang chos mang du zhus/ stong zog gi 'bul ba dpag med phul/ stag lung wol wa ba sogs bla mgo dang grwa rigs mang por dbang lung khrid bcas 'dod mthun du bstsal/ slar 'ba' rom du phebs te bzhugs skabs/ dwags po nas spyan 'dren dang*/ rje rin chen phun tshogs kyi dngul gdung rab gnas la| 'bri gung khang thog gnyis ka nas gsung shog nan chags su byung bas/ dwags po nas gsung ram pa yong ba dang dus bsgrigs te 'bri gung du phebs/ zhal ngo rnams la 'bul ba dang*/ thel pa dang*/ yang ri rnams la mang ja 'gyed bcas sku khyos kyi tshul du gnang*/ dngul gdung la rab gnas mdzad/ gdung rgyud rin po che dang*/ yang ri rnams la dgyes rdor sogs dbang lung mang du gnang*/ rtse ba nas chos rje ma chen dang*/ phag mo nas yum sras rnams kyis spyan drangs tshe dbang brgya rtsa sogs dbang lung du ma bstsal nas dngos rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas te gdan sa chen por phebs/ gcung khri thog pa sogs gzhis bzhugs rnams kyis phebs spro rgyasapar zhus/ sku khyos kyang rgya cher gnang*/ de nas ma 'gyangs par gcung khri thog pa gshegs pas de'i dgongs rdzogs rnams 'tshar phyin pas bstsal| nang rten du rje sgom chung gi sku khri rgyab dang bcas gser zangs la thog tshad las lhag pa nang bzhugs phun sum tshogs par bzhaings/ gzhan yang khyams stod du dbon gnyis kyi khri rgyab dang gser zhu/ bla ma lha khang du sman 'dam las rje nyid kyi 'dra sku phyag nas ma/ thub pa gnas bcu/ gdan rabs dang*/ bka' brgyud pho khrom rnams gser zangs las bsgrubs/ sgom bde rtser yang gdan rabs kyi sku gser zangs las bzhengs/

zangs lung du gdung 'bum dbu thog tu gser 'phru gser thog dang bcas mdzad/ sku 'dra rin po che mthong ba don ldan dang*/ 'dzam gling dpal 'bar gnyis la khyad 'phags kyi ber 'dam dang*/ lha chen gzhan ma rnams la na bza' snyan dar dang*/ lha khang so sor 'phan bla bres/ gser dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal dang*/ ting man ji sogs mchod rdzas bla na med pa bkod pa du mas khyad par du byas te 'bul bar mdzad/ brtsams chos kyang brtag gnyis 'grel chen nyi ma'i 'od zer/ sgom rim gsal bar byed pa legs bshad zla ba'i 'od zer/ gsang sngags spyi bshad nor bu'i 'od zer sogs rnam bshad dang*/ phyag chen chos drug sogs khrid yig du ma dang*/ bde dgyes gsang gsum/ phag mo/ bde mchog lha lnga/ kun rig de nyid bcu drug sogs dkyil chog mang po dang*/ rab gnas sbyin sreg bskang gso sogs mdor na gdan sa 'di nyid deng sang rgyun 'don gyi cho ga dang*/ chos spyod phal cher dam pa 'di nyid kyis mdzad/ gzhan yang tshig nyung la don rgya che ba'i legs bshad mang du gsungs/ de dag kyang phal cher par byang du bkod par mdzad/ chos bzhi gzhung 'grel dang*/ thar pa rin po che'i rgyan yang slar zhus dag mdzad de par du bkod/ gtsug lag khang chen mo'i nub kyi shing bad pa tra dang*/ shar lho'i glo 'bur gsos| thigs khang chen mo bshu 'bubs dang*/ gser thog chen mo zhig gsos kyang mdzad/ zangs lung du rgyun bzhugs kyi sgrub pa ba bco lnga'i phogs yong rdzis mgos dang bcas sbyar/ lha sa bsam yas sogs gtsug lag khang che ba rnams su dkar me snyan dar gtos che ba dang*/ dbus gtsang gi grwa sa che ba ris su ma chad par mang skol rnam bzhag dang bcas/ sgam po'i ri mthil gyi skya ser thams cad la 'gyed chen rnam bzhag dang bcas spong ba yang dag pa lan brgyad dgu tsam dang*/ ma ṇi dung phyur lnga/ bde dgyes gsang gsum stong rtsa gnyis gnyis/ kun rig stong rtsa brgyad/

ltung bshags 'bum ther gcig sman bla stong rtsa nyi shu rtsa grangs sogs mdor na dbyar dgun sprang ston gyis mtha' rten pa'i mchod sbyin rlabs po ches dngos rdzas rnams don ldan sha stag tu sbyor bar mdzad/ grub chu 'don pa dang*/ phyag rjes zhabs rjes 'jog pa/ rgyab skor la chibs pa mdzad de byon pa sogs grub rtags kyi rdzu 'phrul kyang mang du bstan/ thams cad mkhyen pa pad+ma dkar po dang*/ sprul sku bsod nams rgya mtsho yang sgam por phebs/ gnyis ka nas phyag dang phyag mjal dang bor stob pa sogs mjal 'dzoms lugs legs su gnang*/ gtso bor ni sgrub pa kho na'i ngang nas drang nges kyi chos 'khor rgyun mi chad du bskor bas gdul bar bya ba mtha' dag bral smin gyi 'bras bu la bkod do// //lnga pa myang 'das kyi mdzad pa ni| dgung lo bdun cu rtsa lnga spyi lo 1587 la babs pa'i tshe/ da lo mchod pa snga bsnur la thong*/ zla ba phyi ma la brel ba gzhan yong gsung*/ lha chen gyi zhal bkod dang*/ sku rgyu la phyag nas kyang mdzad/ gzhan yang bslab bya'i zhal ta mtha' tshes su gnang*/ sprul pa'i sku yang nyi shar dbyug pas mi khegs pa bzhin 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes te| rgyal nya'i tshes bcu bzhi'i tho rangs chos dbyings su thim pa'i tshul bstan/ de'i tshe sa g.yo ba dang*/ 'ja' 'od kyis gzims chung gang ba sogs ltas dang cho 'phrul bsam pa'i yul las 'das/ sku gdung ni re zhig ril por bzhugs su gsol/ dgongs rdzogs rnams khri rin po che bkra shis kun grags kyi zhabs 'debs bka' chen bkra shis legs pas mdzad de mchod sbyin bla na med pa'i sgo 'phar 'byed par mdzad do// //drug pa slob ma ni/ sgam po nyid du spyan snga thub dbang bstan 'dzin/ khri chen bkra shis kun grags/ chos kyi rje bkra shis phrin las/ sprul sku phrin las rnam rgyal/ rje drung rab 'byams pa bkra shis dpal bzang*/ rdo rje 'dzin pa nyi ma grags pa/

yongs 'dzin bsod nams chos 'phel/ rje spang dkar ba bkra shis chos 'byor/ zhal snga dbon po dge 'dun seng ge sprul sku bkra shis phrin las| bde stengs sprul sku bkra shis rgya mtsho/ grub dbang mi pham bkra shis blo gros/ phyogs nas/ 'bri gung rin po che khu dbon sku mched/ stag lung gzims spyil ba| wol wa ba khu dbon/ 'ba' rom ka bzhi drug gi chos rje/ rgya ston nam mkha' legs pa/ drung pa nam mkha' rdo rje/ nang chen seng ge rgyal mtshan/ tshang sar go shri/ zur mang chos rje pad+ma rgyal po/ gser mdog chos rje grags pa ba/ mar yul ba'i rgyal sras chos rje/ chos rje rngog pa/ lho brag sku skye/ chos rje chos sgo ba/ chos rje cham dgon pa| chos rje khyung tshang pa/ ka bzhi pa/ bla sdings ba sogs bstan pa la phan zhing 'gro ba'i don nus pa'i skyes chen mang du byon no// zhes pa 'di dag ni rnam thar snying po bsdus pa dang*/ mos gus kyi dpal ster las kyang cung zad bsdus te bkod pa'o// zhes pa 'di ni sgam po chen po'i seng khrir chos smra ba'i res su 'khod pa shākya'i dge slong bzang po'i mtshan can gyis chu stag spyi lo 1662 lor mdzad pa'i/ gangs can 'dir ston pa'i rgyal tshab dpal sgam po pa'i khri gdung 'dzin pa'i dam pa rnams kyi gtam bai ḍūr+ya'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so zhes dwags la sgam po'i par ma'i shog ldeb 49 na 1nas rim par gsal ba ji bzhin zur du phyung ba'o/// /
